The Green Wave, led by second-year head coach [[Mike Dunleavy Sr.]], played their home games at [[Devlin Fieldhouse]] in [[New Orleans|New Orleans, Louisiana]] as fourth-year members of the [[American Athletic Conference]].{{cite web|url=http://tulanegreenwave.com/documents/2017/9/1/TulaneMBB_QF_2018.pdf |title=Tulane Athletics |publisher=TulaneGreenWave.com |date= |accessdate=2017-11-11}}{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/team/_/id/2655/tulane-green-wave |title=Tulane Green Wave College Basketball – Tulane News, Scores, Stats, Rumors & More |publisher=ESPN |date= |accessdate=2017-11-11}} They finished the season 14–17, 5–13 in [[2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to finish in 10th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Temple]]. == Previous season == The [[2016–17 Tulane Green Wave men's basketball team|Green Wave]] finished the season 6–25, 3–15 in AAC play to finish in tenth place.
